body: S100-01: rest/meditate command; isResting flag; +5%/+3% HP/MP per tick; cancelled by attack/aggro. stand cancels manually. S100-02: target <mob> command; substring match in zone; hpBar display. S100-03: /p <msg> party chat shortcut; broadcasts to party members only.
